paras: The rufous-throated fulvetta (Schoeniparus rufogularis) is a species of bird in the family Pellorneidae.
It is found in southeastern Asia from the Himalayas through Indochina to southwestern Cambodia.
Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forest.
